verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves sharp endpoint reduction, epsilon-global optimization of the ex ante basis criterion, and strict triangle separation, but it does not establish that the deployable stable selector approaches the unrestricted observable optimum. Its end-to-end theorem retains the potentially first-order stability price b_n^{st}; neither the Zhao design-rate assumptions nor any other primitive condition make that term vanish, so the stated first-order conclusion assumes its load-bearing missing step. The relative-open strict result concerns the basis objective, whereas strict observable improvement is proved only for one fixed n=3 pair of tie representatives and not for the selected procedures throughout that neighborhood. The arbitrary-real optimizer is also a nonconstructive measurable selector, while finite certification is restricted to exact algebraic inputs. The framing does not falsely advertise a matched or universally sharp result, but the delivered contribution remains a specialized robust-design construction rather than a field-level observable-performance theorem.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Derive an explicit rate for b_n^{st} by balancing vanishing rank-specific spectral thresholds against the bridge remainder. Then combine that rate with the proved pilot bounds to obtain observable regret relative to v_mm^+ without assuming the full error sum is o(n^{-1}).
